classification.difficultyReason: Direct perimeter sums. Part a needs one mm to cm conversion and a tick-marked equal side. Part b needs one mm to cm conversion. Slightly more than the all-cm p13-q8 but less than building a length in p12-q5.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of each of these shapes. Answer in cm.

answer.worked:
The matching marks show that two sides are equal.
$$\begin{align*}52\text{ mm}&=5.2\text{ cm}\\P&=7+5.2+5.2\\P&=17.4\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
